text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Finally found you! Why didn't you answer 
me?!

One day, I spotted Stay Gold being 
cornered by Sweep Tosho...

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
What's up, what's up, taking so long. Is 
that a reply...?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Geez! I LANE'd you, didn't I?! I told you 
I'd put on my special magic potion!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Eeeh~? A "magic potion"...? Sweep-chan, 
you're being pushy again...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Ta-da! It's a magical mud pack♪

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
I mixed fermented fruit and a drop of 
snail slime into rice paddy mud...! Then I 
bathed it in moonlight to imbue it with 
magical power!!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Urk! That's a bit much...! You've gotta be 
kidding, we're really doing that...!?

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Oho, so you want me to smear that on my 
face?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
That's right! It'll leave you looking all 
dewy and glowing♪ You never take care of 
your skin, after all! You should be 
thanking me!

Should I stop them...! Just as the thought 
crossed my mind--

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Heh...! Ahahaha! Doesn't that sound 
interesting?

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
I've seen folk remedies like that during 
my travels too. Though over there, they 
crushed ants and rubbed them on their 
skin...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
"Eeeh, what is that?! What kind of magic 
is it?!"

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, let's see... I'll talk while handling 
that for you. The dorm's washroom... nah, 
any faucet around here will do.

—A few days later. When I asked about what 
happened back then...

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Ah, it wasn't bad. It's not like I usually 
use face packs, after all.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
That was a nice change of pace. Magic and 
beauty care are nice once in a while.
